method.palette_only: same normalized front+back pixel/color topology with different RGB palette
method.same_silhouette: same normalized front+back foreground geometry with altered internal pixels
method.policy: Do not treat palette-only custom variants as new Pokémon designs. Keep canon form aliases/reference sprites separate from custom approval candidates.

immediate_filter: The custom approval pool is reduced from 995 rows to 945 structurally distinct designs before semantic/source overlap review. Palette-only custom variants, exact duplicate art, and placeholders are not approval candidates.
next_pass: Collapse semantic/source overlap among the 945 distinct custom designs, then run DS-quality READY/POLISH/REWORK/REJECT review. Recolor flags remain excluded unless a canon form must be retained as an official reference.
